questions.stem_text: _______________ is the central node of 802.11 wireless operations.
questions.answer_explanation: The Access Point serves as the central hub in 802.11 wireless networks, facilitating communication between wireless clients and the wired network, thus playing a crucial role in managing network traffic and connectivity.

questions.stem_text: How does a buffer overflow on the stack facilitate running attacker-injected code?

options.A: By overwriting the return address to point to the location of that code
options.B: By writing directly to the instruction pointer register the address of the code
options.C: By writing directly to %eax the address of the code
options.D: By changing the name of the running executable, stored on the stack

questions.answer_explanation: A buffer overflow allows an attacker to overwrite the return address on the stack, enabling the execution of malicious code located at the specified address when the function returns.

questions.stem_text:
Which of the following styles of fuzzer is more likely to explore paths covering every
line of code in the following program?
questions.answer_explanation: Whitebox fuzzers have access to the internal structure and logic of the program, allowing them to systematically explore and test all possible execution paths, thereby increasing the likelihood of covering every line of code.

questions.stem_text:
Local caching of files is common in distributed file systems, but it has the disadvantage
that

options.A: Temporary inconsistencies among views of a file by different machines can result
options.B: The file system is likely to be corrupted when a computer crashes
options.C: A much higher amount of network traffic results

questions.answer_explanation: Local caching can lead to temporary inconsistencies because different machines may access stale data from their caches instead of the most recent version stored on the network, resulting in divergent views of the same file.

A digital signature relies on a public-key system because it uses asymmetric cryptography, where a private key is used to create the signature and a corresponding public key is used to verify its authenticity, ensuring both security and non-repudiation.

questions.stem_text: Encryption and decryption do not provide integrity, which ensures data is not altered during transmission.
questions.answer_explanation: Encryption and decryption primarily focus on ensuring confidentiality by converting data into a secure format and then back into its original form, but they do not inherently verify whether the data has been altered during transmission, which is the role of integrity measures such as hashing or checksums.

questions.stem_text: The addition of the two's-complement numbers 10000001 and 10101010 will result in overflow.
questions.answer_explanation: The addition of the two's-complement numbers 10000001 (which is -127 in decimal) and 10101010 (which is -86 in decimal) results in -213, but since the result exceeds the representable range of an 8-bit two's-complement number (-128 to 127), it causes overflow.

questions.stem_text: A virus is a hidden part of a program that masquerades as a legitimate application to gain access to a system.
questions.answer_explanation: The statement is false because a virus is not a hidden part of a program that masquerades as a legitimate application; rather, it is a standalone malicious code that replicates itself and infects other programs or files, while the description provided more accurately characterizes a type of malware known as a trojan horse.

questions.stem_text: All bit strings with more ones than zeros cannot be described using a regular expression due to their non-regular nature.
questions.answer_explanation: The statement is true because the language of bit strings with more ones than zeros cannot be recognized by a finite automaton, thus making it non-regular and unable to be described by a regular expression.

questions.stem_text: The solution to the recurrence f(2 N + 1) = f(2 N) = f(N) + log N is O(N log N).
questions.answer_explanation: The recurrence f(2 N + 1) = f(2 N) = f(N) + log N suggests a logarithmic growth rather than O(N log N) because the additional log N term does not dominate the overall growth rate, leading to a solution that is more accurately characterized as O(N) instead.

questions.stem_text: Write a python function to find the nth digit in the proper fraction of two given numbers.
questions.answer_explanation: correct because it outlines the structure of a Python function that takes two integers, p and q, representing the numerator and denominator of a fraction, along with an integer N, to determine the Nth digit in the decimal representation of the fraction p/q.

Write a function to group the 1 st elements on the basis of 2 nd elements in the given
